 THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 54(1) OF LAC ACT,
1894, AGAINST THE AWARD DATED 24.04.2015 PASSED ON LAC.NO.479/2014 ON THE FILE OF THE ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE, HASSAN, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FURTHER ORDERS, THIS DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE ANU SIVARAMAN  and  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE K.MANMADHA RAO  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE ANU SIVARAMAN)
1.
This appeal is filed seeking enhancement of the compensation with respect to 20 guntas of land in Sy.No.313/2 situated at Doranahosahalli village, Kattaya Hobli, Hassan Taluk and District.
NC: 2025:KHC:25327-DB HC-KAR 2.

It is submitted that in respect of the neighbouring land under the very same Notification, this Court has considered the issue in M.F.A. No.10457/2018 and connected matter and has ordered the grant of compensation at the rate of Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta with interest and statutory benefits.
3. It is submitted that all the contentions raised by the learned counsel for the respondents has also been considered in the said judgment.

4. Having considered the contentions advanced, we notice that all the judgments relied on by the learned counsel for the respondent - beneficiary has been referred to at paragraph 7 of the judgment dated 05.02.2025, which is relied on by the learned counsel for the appellant.

sentences.text: In the above view of the matter and in view of the fact that several Miscellaneous First Appeals have already been considered by this Court and the NC: 2025:KHC:25327-DB HC-KAR enhanced market value of the land at Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta with all statutory benefits has been upheld by this Court and since the Notification in question as well as the nature of the land Notification in question is identical and the land is also situated in Sy.No.313/2 of the same village, Hobli and taluk,
we are of the opinion that the said judgment is applicable to the present case as well.
6. In the above view of the matter, we proceed to pass the following -  ORDER  i.
The appeal is allowed.

ii. The market value of the land measuring 20  guntas in Sy.No.313/2 situated at  Doranahosahalli village, Kattaya Hobli,
Hassan Taluk and District is re-determined at Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta with interest and statutory benefits.
The claimant is not NC: 2025:KHC:25327-DB HC-KAR entitled to the interest for the delay period of 1247 days.
iii. No order as to costs.
